blocks.fullContent: Session opens on the Forge Sheet build kickoff. All three provings completed this heat: FLY-72 (inline storage decided), FLY-73 (Stop hook confirmed), FLY-74 (semantic audit v1 scope confirmed). FLY-75 (state format schema) is the active task.

blocks.digest: Inline storage: fullContent is required in every block — not optional.
blocks.fullContent: Decision from FLY-72: store fullContent inline in state.json as a required field. At 30 blocks per session, one session is 24.4 KB. At 30 sessions, 732 KB — JSON.parse completes in ~7ms. Reference storage rejected: adds complexity with no benefit at this scale.

blocks.digest: State schema is locked. FLY-76 (shell P1) can begin immediately after this task ships.
blocks.fullContent: The state.json schema is now canonical and locked for v1. The four fixture files cover all four captured states. FLY-76 (shell P1 — live sheet) is unblocked and can begin.
